claim: Louisiana Tax Commission hears real and personal property appeals from board of review actions; hearings begin within ten days of receiving the certified assessment lists.
All Louisiana Tax Commission decisions are final unless appealed to district court within thirty days.
Taxpayer dissatisfied with a final Tax Commission decision may sue within thirty days in the district court for the parish where the Commission is domiciled or where the property is located.
A taxpayer who sues must pay taxes under protest (or timely move to set bond/security); undisputed taxes are paid without protest.
Board of review hears owners' complaints on assessments; its determinations are final unless appealed to the Tax Commission under Commission rules.

Board of review must convene hearings on or before September 15 and certify the list to the Tax Commission on or before October 20 each year; assessors certify rolls to the board on or before October 1.
Land and residential improvements are assessed at 10% of fair market value.
